title: Final-readiness evidence binding with cross-report hash verification

defect_summary.no_cross_report_binding: final_map_readiness_gate aggregated sub-reports (static XODR, connector, visual, perception) but never verified they were all evaluated against the SAME XODR artifact. A stale or mismatched sub-report could be silently included.
defect_summary.no_evidence_manifest: No manifest of sub-report files and their SHA256 hashes was included in the final readiness report, making it impossible to audit which exact reports were consumed.
defect_summary.carla_unavailable_masked: carla_visual_smoke_gate returned CARLA_VISUAL_READY='skipped' when CARLA was disabled by env, conflating 'optional not run' with 'external dependency unavailable' - no way for downstream consumers to distinguish.
defect_summary.no_screenshot_binding: Visual gate captured screenshots but didn't record their SHA256 or bind them to the XODR they were generated from, so screenshot substitution was undetectable.
defect_summary.perception_visual_decoupled: Perception status report could reference a different visual gate report than the one actually evaluated.

corrected_semantics.cross_report_xodr_binding: All sub-reports loaded by final_map_readiness_gate are verified to have xodr_sha256 matching the target XODR. Mismatch -> sub-report marked with binding_error, gate fails. Missing xodr_sha256 is tolerated (backwards compatible) but logged.
corrected_semantics.evidence_manifest: Final report includes evidence_manifest array listing every sub-report with path and SHA256 hash, enabling full audit trail.
corrected_semantics.xodr_binding_verification: Final report includes xodr_binding_verification object with per-sub-report ok/reason status.
corrected_semantics.carla_blocked_external: Visual gate returns CARLA_VISUAL_READY='blocked_external' and status='blocked_external' when CARLA is disabled/unavailable (fail-closed external dependency), distinct from 'skipped' (optional not-run). evaluate_visual_smoke_report propagates this as a distinct gate state.
corrected_semantics.screenshot_hash_binding: Each captured screenshot now includes its SHA256 and the XODR SHA256 it was generated from in the visual gate report.
corrected_semantics.perception_gate_includes_visual_hash: Perception gate evaluation now has access to visual gate report for binding verification (though current perception_status schema doesn't include visual_report_sha, the infrastructure is in place).

coverage.test_run_gate_disabled_by_env_skips_clea: Updated to expect CARLA_VISUAL_READY='blocked_external' and status='blocked_external'
coverage.test_build_report_happy_path_all_gates_p: Updated to include evidence_manifest and xodr_binding_verification in assertions

residual_risks: Perception status schema doesn't yet include visual_gate_report_sha256 field; binding is enforced by final_map_readiness_gate at load time but not embedded in perception report itself.
Connector report and static XODR report schemas don't mandate xodr_sha256 field; missing field is tolerated (backwards compatible) but doesn't guarantee binding.
CARLA unavailable distinction (blocked_external vs skipped) is new - downstream consumers (e.g. cook scripts) may need updates to handle the new status.
Screenshot SHA256 is recorded but not yet verified by any downstream consumer (evidence-only for now).
